com.ecom.admin.release_notes: Pay method is now a setting. Choose Check only, Cash only, or Check + Cash for your shop in Settings > Configuration > Pay Method. Individual employees can override it on their contract, with a fixed check amount for the Check + Cash option. Payroll no longer asks you to type the split every pay period - the check and cash fields fill in from the setting, and you can still override a single week by tapping the field.
